title: No Surprises Act: Reasonable or Unreasonable Premium Impact
discussion_signal: The post separates patient protection at the point of care from downstream arbitration and premium effects. It treats provider participation and the high-volume IDR channel as a distributional question: a remedy can remove surprise billing for patients while costs and leverage shift among providers, plans, employers, and members.
linked_research_question: How does policy discussion interpret the No Surprises Act tradeoff between patient protection, provider participation, arbitration leverage, and premium affordability?
limits: Individual professional interpretation with selected replies
The post uses multiple secondary sources and is not a causal evaluation
Premium effects and provider participation are not established for all markets
